Subject: Your land dispute matter

Dear Ms. Pai,

Thank you for meeting us on 19/08/2020 about your dispute with Rekha Karve. As we understand it, construction has started on the disputed plot.

Our advice is to seek a temporary injunction to stop construction on the plot. Please collect photographs of the construction and the land records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹4.8 crore.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
